verdict.rationale: Running a device-control agent against a simulator, VM or container first is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes the agent running on a real iPhone through the ESP32 board. The closest item, board_test.py, debugs the board over BLE from a Mac without the phone app; that is a hardware test tool, not a sandboxed environment for running the agent, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a sandboxed VM or container before pointing it at a real device
